title: Saylani IT Park Multan, Multan | SMIT Campus Location & Details
text: SMIT Campus: Saylani IT Park Multan, located in Multan, Pakistan. Address: Service road, near new Khan bus terminal, Vehari Chowk, Multan. This is one of Saylani Mass IT Training's (SMIT) training centers where free IT courses are delivered on-site. To check current course availability at this campus or enroll, visit https://www.saylanimit.com/enroll and select Multan as the city.
